Wilsonville, Oregon

Junk removal in Wilsonville

Wilsonville is thirty road miles from our base at the south end of I-205, just inside Zone 4. Neighborhoods run from the golf course homes of Charbonneau to the newer streets of Villebois and Frog Pond, plus plenty of apartments near Town Center.

Charbonneau's retirement community means many downsizing jobs, with furniture, china cabinets and boxes of keepsakes to sort. In Villebois the call is more often a garage or a move out. We work at the pace you need, and we can leave anything you decide to keep in a room you choose.

How it works

Three steps. That's the whole thing.

  1. Pick your size

    Choose the size that looks like your pile, or send a photo. Your price shows up right away.

  2. Pick a day

    Choose a day and an arrival window. Pay securely online, no phone tag.

  3. We haul it

    We show up, do all the lifting and loading, and sweep up after.

What we take

If it fits in the truck, it can go.

Furniture

Couches, chairs, tables, dressers, desks.

Appliances

Fridges, freezers, washers, dryers, stoves.

Mattresses

Any size, with or without the box spring.

Garage and basement

Boxes, shelves, tools and everything in between.

Yard debris

Branches, clippings, old fencing, sheds taken apart.

Move outs

What didn't make the moving truck.

Electronics

TVs, monitors, computers, printers.

Estate cleanouts

A whole home, handled with care.

We can't take paint, chemicals, fuel, asbestos or medical waste.

Wilsonville questions

Good to know

Do you help with downsizing in Charbonneau?

Yes. Tell us what is staying and what is going, and we take only what you point to. We can deliver usable furniture to a donation center for you.

Can you haul from a Villebois townhome with a small garage?

Yes. We load from the driveway or the street. Let us know if there is a parking rule for moving trucks.

Is there a travel charge to Wilsonville?

Yes. Wilsonville is in our zone 4, so travel adds $75.00 per visit to the load price. It is shown in your price before you book.

Which Wilsonville ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97070. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
